name: EPR Properties
outlook:
What EPR Properties says to expect

  • Full year 2026: FFOAA per diluted shareThe Company is increasing its 2026 earnings guidance for FFOAA per diluted common share to a range of $5.49 to $5.57 from a range of $5.41 to $5.57, representing an increase of 8.0% at the midpoint over 2025.
  • Full year 2026: investment spendingThe Company is also increasing investment spending guidance for 2026 to a range of $675.0 million to $725.0 million from a range of $600.0 million to $700.0 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
